# SIA DAGAR

> SIA DAGAR (DAGAR) is a Latvia-based company providing project management and
> consulting services since 2012, headquartered in Riga. It operates across
> Latvia, Poland, Ukraine, Lithuania and Estonia.

## About

DAGAR delivers full-cycle project management and consulting. The company works
with clients internationally and focuses on reliable, on-time delivery with a
focused approach in every industry.

## Services (project management & consulting in these areas)

- Energy: industrial gas supply; renewable energy — biogas and biomethane.
- Business Development: developing new markets, partnerships and growth directions.
- Product Development: product design and development, from concept to market.
- ICT: information and communication technology solutions and projects.

## Markets

Latvia (LV), Poland (PL), Ukraine (UA), Lithuania (LT), Estonia (EE).

## FAQ

- What does DAGAR do? Project management and consulting in energy, business development, product development and ICT.
- Which industries? Energy (industrial gas supply; renewable energy — biogas and biomethane), real estate, retail, manufacturing and ICT.
- Which markets? Latvia, Poland, Ukraine, Lithuania and Estonia.
- How long operating? Since 2012, headquartered in Riga, Latvia.
- Renewable energy (biogas, biomethane)? Yes — one of DAGAR's core areas.
- Pricing? Set individually, based on the project's scope, complexity and needs.
- How to start? Email dagar@dagar.lv or call +371 29185303.
- Languages? Latvian, English and Russian.

## Process (how we work)

1. Consultation — clarify your needs and goals.
2. Proposal & plan — prepare a solution and a work plan.
3. Execution — manage the project and coordinate delivery.
4. Result & support — hand over the result and provide support.
